remarks: Welcome to 44 Knollwood Lane, a stunning residence nestled on one of the most desired streets in Darien. This exquisite property is a perfect blend of classic elegance and modern amenities, with ample opportunity to expand the existing traditional colonial. making it an ideal sanctuary for those seeking comfort and sophistication. The main level boasts a fully renovated gourmet kitchen, equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, dining area, and a formal dining room. The living room, complete with a wood-burning fireplace, provides a warm and inviting space for gatherings and quiet nights in. Enjoy the serene views from the screened-in porch, perfect for relaxing with a morning coffee or evening read. In addition the main floor also has a versatile fourth bedroom option with an adjacent bathroom, ideal for guests or as a home office. Upstairs, the primary bedroom suite presents a serene retreat with an en-suite bathroom and the 2 additional bedrooms are spacious, and well-appointed.  Situated on a generous one acre of flat, dry land, this property presents a fantastic opportunity to transform this classic colonial into your dream home. The expansive grounds provide ample space for outdoor activities and future enhancements, all while maintaining a sense of privacy and tranquility.
